mapper.select:
SELECT base.actionItemId AS actionItemId, pc.id AS potentialCustomerId, pc.name AS customerName, pc.gender AS gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age, pc.birth_date AS birthDate, base.nextInsuranceAgeShiftDate AS insuranceAgeShiftDate,
CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(base.nextInsuranceAgeShiftDate, CURDATE()) = 0 THEN 'D-DAY' ELSE CONCAT('D-', DATEDIFF(base.nextInsuranceAgeShiftDate, CURDATE())) END AS ageChangeLabel,
CONCAT_WS('|', CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(pc.birth_date, '%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%m-%d') THEN '오늘 생일' ELSE NULL END,
CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(base.nextInsuranceAgeShiftDate, CURDATE()) = 30 THEN '상령일 D-30' WHEN DATEDIFF(base.nextInsuranceAgeShiftDate, CURDATE()) = 7 THEN '상령일 D-7' WHEN DATEDIFF(base.nextInsuranceAgeShiftDate, CURDATE()) = 0 THEN '상령일 D-DAY' ELSE NULL END,
CASE WHEN base.hasThreeStepCaseA = 1 THEN '가족 통합 리모델링' ELSE NULL END ) AS contactReason,
CASE WHEN base.badgeTriggerTypeCode = '06' THEN '가족 통합 리모델링' WHEN base.badgeTriggerTypeCode = '07' THEN '자녀 보장 점검' WHEN base.badgeTriggerTypeCode = '08' THEN '부모 건강 점검' ELSE NULL END AS badgeName,
CASE WHEN base.badgeTriggerTypeCode = '06' THEN 'RED' WHEN base.badgeTriggerTypeCode = '07' THEN 'ORANGE' WHEN base.badgeTriggerTypeCode = '08' THEN 'YELLOW' ELSE NULL END AS badgeColor,
pc.consult_status_code AS consultStatusCode, consult_code.code_name AS consultStatusName,
CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(pc.birth_date, '%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%m-%d') AND COALESCE(wr.webform_status_code, '01') = '01' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS webFormSendEnabled,
COALESCE(wr.webform_status_code, '01') AS webFormStatusCode, webform_code.code_name AS webFormStatusName,
cr.id AS reportId,
CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(base.nextInsuranceAgeShiftDate, CURDATE()) = 0 AND COALESCE(cr.send_status_code, '01') != '02' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS reportSendEnabled,
cr.send_status_code AS reportSendStatusCode,
CASE WHEN cr.send_status_code = '02' THEN '발송완료' ELSE send_code.code_name END AS reportSendStatusName,
base.priorityScore AS priorityScore
FROM ( SELECT dai.sales_user_id, dai.customer_id, MIN(dai.id) AS actionItemId, MAX(dai.priority_score) AS priorityScore, MIN(dai.created_at) AS createdAt,
MAX( CASE WHEN dai.trigger_type_code = '06' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS hasThreeStepCaseA,
MAX( CASE WHEN dai.trigger_type_code IN ('06', '07', '08') THEN dai.trigger_type_code ELSE NULL END ) AS badgeTriggerTypeCode,
COALESCE( pc_inner.insurance_age_shift_date, CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR(CURDATE()), '-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(pc_inner.birth_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%m-%d') ), '%Y-%m-%d' ) < CURDATE() THEN DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR(CURDATE()), '-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(pc_inner.birth_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%m-%d') ), '%Y-%m-%d' ), INTERVAL 1 YEAR ) ELSE STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR(CURDATE()), '-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(pc_inner.birth_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%m-%d') ), '%Y-%m-%d' ) END ) AS nextInsuranceAgeShiftDate
FROM daily_action_item dai
INNER JOIN potential_customer pc_inner ON dai.customer_id = pc_inner.id
WHERE dai.sales_user_id = #{salesUserId} AND dai.target_date = CURDATE() AND dai.is_completed = FALSE AND dai.conversion_status_code = '01' AND pc_inner.is_active = FALSE /* 오늘 연락 고객에서 졸업 고객 제외*/
GROUP BY dai.sales_user_id, dai.customer_id, pc_inner.birth_date, pc_inner.insurance_age_shift_date
HAVING DATE_FORMAT(pc_inner.birth_date, '%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%m-%d') OR DATEDIFF(nextInsuranceAgeShiftDate, CURDATE()) IN (30, 7, 0) OR hasThreeStepCaseA = 1 ) base
INNER JOIN potential_customer pc ON base.customer_id = pc.id AND pc.is_active = FALSE /* 최종 조회에서도 한 번 더 졸업 고객 제외 */
LEFT JOIN common_code consult_code ON consult_code.group_code = 'CONSULT_STATUS' AND consult_code.code_value = pc.consult_status_code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wi1.customer_id, wi1.conversion_status_code, wi1.webform_status_code FROM webform_issuance wi1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, conversion_status_code, MAX(id) AS latest_issuance_id FROM webform_issuance WHERE conversion_status_code = '01' GROUP BY customer_id, conversion_status_code ) latest_wi ON wi1.id = latest_wi.latest_issuance_id ) wr ON wr.customer_id = pc.id AND wr.conversion_status_code = '01'
LEFT JOIN common_code webform_code ON webform_code.group_code = 'WEBFORM_STATUS' AND webform_code.code_value = COALESCE(wr.webform_status_code, '01')
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cr1.id, cr1.customer_id, cr1.conversion_status_code, cr1.send_status_code FROM customer_report cr1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, conversion_status_code, MAX(id) AS latest_report_id FROM customer_report WHERE conversion_status_code = '01' GROUP BY customer_id, conversion_status_code ) latest_cr ON cr1.id = latest_cr.latest_report_id ) cr ON cr.customer_id = pc.id AND cr.conversion_status_code = '01'
LEFT JOIN common_code send_code ON send_code.group_code = 'SEND_STATUS' AND send_code.code_value = cr.send_status_code
ORDER BY CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(base.nextInsuranceAgeShiftDate, CURDATE()) = 0 THEN 1 WHEN DATEDIFF(base.nextInsuranceAgeShiftDate, CURDATE()) = 7 THEN 2 WHEN DATEDIFF(base.nextInsuranceAgeShiftDate, CURDATE()) = 30 THEN 3 WHEN base.hasThreeStepCaseA = 1 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, base.priorityScore DESC, base.createdAt ASC
